_comment: Copy to automations/housekeeping.labels.json to change the words housekeeping.py expects. 'base' = built-in set to start from (en | pl); every other key overrides it. Object keys (fields, statuses, sections, events, messages) are merged key by key; strings and lists are replaced. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Full key list: README.md, section 'Label sets'.
